sentence.en: There is a courtyard in front of the shrine.

observe.ko: 줄로 표시한 세 칸과 앞뒤 간격을 살펴봐요. 이 위에 사당이 서고, 앞쪽으로 사람이 다가와 들어갈 거예요.
observe.en: Look at the three bays marked by the strings and the space from front to back. The shrine will stand here, with people approaching and entering from the front.
observe.de: Schau dir die drei mit Schnüren abgesteckten Felder und ihre Tiefe an. Hier entsteht der Schrein, dem man sich von vorn nähert und den man von dort betritt.

steps.preserve: Installed structure retains the same nodes and thickness; only newly added parts and physically justified occlusion change.

productionNote.ko: 세 칸과 앞쪽 접근 공간을 확보하고 주거용 방·부엌으로 나누지 않습니다.
productionNote.en: Reserve three bays and a front approach; do not divide this into residential rooms and a kitchen.
productionNote.de: Drei Felder und der vordere Zugang sind vorgesehen; es entstehen keine Wohnräume mit Küche.

sentence.en: People step up using the stone step.
sentence.de: Über die Steinstufe gelangt man hinauf.

observe.ko: 기단과 디딤돌에는 높이 차가 있어요. 땅에서 사당 안으로 올라가는 길을 찾아봐요.
observe.en: The base and stepping stones form different levels. Find the way up from the ground into the shrine.
observe.de: Sockel und Trittsteine bilden unterschiedliche Höhen. Such den Weg vom Boden hinauf in den Schrein.

steps.preserve: Installed structure retains the same nodes and thickness; only newly added parts and physically justified occlusion change.

productionNote.ko: 정본의 낮은 기단과 가운데 디딤돌 위치를 유지합니다.
productionNote.en: Keep the master’s low base and central step position.
productionNote.de: Der niedrige Sockel und die mittige Stufe folgen dem Original.

sentence.en: Padstones are placed beneath the posts.
sentence.de: Unter die Pfosten kommen Stützensteine.

observe.ko: 초석이 놓인 곳이 기둥이 설 자리예요. 앞쪽과 뒤쪽 받침을 연결해 보면 건물의 깊이가 보여요.
observe.en: The padstones mark where the posts will stand. Connecting the front and rear supports reveals the building’s depth.
observe.de: Die Stützensteine markieren die Pfostenplätze. Vorder- und Hinterreihe machen die Gebäudetiefe sichtbar.

steps.preserve: Installed structure retains the same nodes and thickness; only newly added parts and physically justified occlusion change.

productionNote.ko: 앞뒤 기둥열의 받침이 같은 기준점에서 시작합니다.
productionNote.en: Supports for both post rows begin at shared fixed points.
productionNote.de: Die Auflager beider Pfostenreihen beginnen an gemeinsamen festen Bezugspunkten.

sentence.en: Three bays take shape between the posts.
sentence.de: Zwischen den Pfosten entstehen drei Felder.

observe.ko: 정면의 둥근 기둥 네 개 사이에 세 칸이 생겨요. 뒤쪽 기둥까지 이어지는 실내 공간을 보세요.
observe.en: Four round front posts define three bays. Notice the interior space extending to the rear posts.
observe.de: Vier runde Pfosten an der Vorderseite bilden drei Felder. Dahinter reicht der Innenraum bis zur hinteren Pfostenreihe.

steps.preserve: Installed structure retains the same nodes and thickness; only newly added parts and physically justified occlusion change.

productionNote.ko: 정면 원기둥 네 개와 뒤쪽 구조가 제례 공간의 깊이를 만듭니다.
productionNote.en: Four round front posts and the rear structure define the ritual space’s depth.
productionNote.de: Vier runde vordere Pfosten und die rückwärtige Konstruktion bilden die Tiefe des Ritualraums.

sentence.en: The brackets support the roof structure.
sentence.de: Die Konsolen tragen die Dachkonstruktion.

observe.ko: 기둥 위의 공포와 보, 도리를 차례로 찾아봐요. 지붕은 그 위에서 이어져요.
observe.en: Find the bracket sets, beams and purlins above the posts. The roof continues above them.
observe.de: Such über den Pfosten die Konsolen, Balken und Pfetten. Darüber setzt sich das Dach fort.

steps.preserve: Installed structure retains the same nodes and thickness; only newly added parts and physically justified occlusion change.

productionNote.ko: 공포를 기둥머리에 놓고 보·도리를 연결합니다. 단청은 뒤의 마감 단계입니다.
productionNote.en: Set brackets on the post heads and connect beams and purlins; painted decoration comes later.
productionNote.de: Konsolen sitzen auf den Pfostenköpfen und verbinden Balken und Pfetten; die Bemalung folgt später.

sentence.en: The rafters form the two sides of the roof.
sentence.de: Die Sparren bilden die beiden Dachseiten.

observe.ko: 맞배지붕의 앞뒤 두 면이 용마루에서 만나요. 서까래가 두 방향의 처마로 이어져요.
observe.en: The two sides of the gabled roof meet at the ridge. Rafters run toward the eaves on either side.
observe.de: Die beiden Flächen des Satteldachs treffen am First zusammen. Sparren führen zu den Traufen auf beiden Seiten.

steps.preserve: Installed structure retains the same nodes and thickness; only newly added parts and physically justified occlusion change.

productionNote.ko: 앞뒤 두 지붕면을 사용합니다. 안사랑채의 팔작 모서리를 복사하지 않습니다.
productionNote.en: Use front and rear roof slopes; do not copy Ansarangchae’s hipped corners.
productionNote.de: Es gibt eine vordere und eine hintere Dachfläche; die Walm-Ecken des Ansarangchae werden nicht übernommen.

sentence.en: The roof underlayers lie above the rafters.
sentence.de: Der Dachunterbau liegt über den Sparren.

observe.ko: 기와가 올라갈 바탕을 살펴봐요. 서까래 위에 놓인 층이 지붕의 두께를 만들어요.
observe.en: Look at the base for the tiles. Layers above the rafters give the roof its thickness.
observe.de: Betrachte den Unterbau für die Ziegel. Die Schichten über den Sparren geben dem Dach seine Stärke.

steps.preserve: Installed structure retains the same nodes and thickness; only newly added parts and physically justified occlusion change.

productionNote.ko: 맞배의 두 경사면에 두께를 쌓고 박공 위치를 고정합니다.
productionNote.en: Build up thickness on both slopes and keep the gable position fixed.
productionNote.de: Auf beiden Dachflächen entstehen Schichten; die Giebellage bleibt fest.

sentence.en: The gable is visible at the side of the roof.
sentence.de: An der Dachseite ist der Giebel zu sehen.

observe.ko: 지붕 옆의 박공과 앞쪽 처마를 비교해 보세요. 사당의 맞배지붕 형태가 드러나요.
observe.en: Compare the gable at the side with the eaves at the front. Together they reveal the shrine’s gabled roof.
observe.de: Vergleiche den seitlichen Giebel mit der vorderen Traufe. Daran erkennst du die Satteldachform des Schreins.

steps.preserve: Installed structure retains the same nodes and thickness; only newly added parts and physically justified occlusion change.

productionNote.ko: 용마루·처마·오른쪽 박공 윤곽을 정본과 맞춥니다.
productionNote.en: Align ridge, eaves and right gable outline with the master.
productionNote.de: First, Traufe und rechter Giebelumriss werden am Original ausgerichtet.

sentence.en: There is a wooden floor inside the doorway.
sentence.de: Hinter der Tür liegt ein Holzboden.

observe.ko: 널을 깔아 사람이 들어가 설 수 있는 마루가 생겼어요. 마루의 앞모서리와 안쪽으로 이어지는 널의 방향을 살펴봐요.
observe.en: The floorboards form a wooden floor people can enter and stand on. Look at its front edge and the direction of the boards extending into the room.
observe.de: Die Dielen bilden einen Holzboden, auf dem man den Raum betreten und stehen kann. Schau dir die Vorderkante und die Richtung der Dielen im Inneren an.

steps.preserve: Installed structure retains the same nodes and thickness; only newly added parts and physically justified occlusion change.

productionNote.ko: 귀틀과 청판으로 내부 바닥을 만들고 온돌·침구·부엌을 추가하지 않습니다.
productionNote.en: Build the timber floor frame and boards without adding ondol, bedding or a kitchen.
productionNote.de: Bodenrahmen und Dielen bilden den Innenboden; Ondol, Bettzeug oder Küche werden nicht ergänzt.

sentence.en: The lattice doors sit behind the posts.
sentence.de: Die Gittertüren liegen hinter den Pfosten.

observe.ko: 창호는 앞 기둥보다 뒤에 있어요. 문을 지나 들어갈 실내와 앞쪽 툇공간을 구분해 보세요.
observe.en: The doors are set behind the front posts. Distinguish the interior beyond them from the space in front.
observe.de: Die Türen liegen hinter den vorderen Pfosten. Unterscheide den Innenraum dahinter vom Bereich davor.

steps.preserve: Installed structure retains the same nodes and thickness; only newly added parts and physically justified occlusion change.

productionNote.ko: 세 쌍 창호와 측벽을 후퇴면에 놓고 문짝이 열릴 여유를 남깁니다.
productionNote.en: Place three pairs of lattice doors and side walls behind the posts, leaving room to open the doors.
productionNote.de: Drei Türpaare und die Seitenwände liegen hinter den Pfosten; für das Öffnen bleibt Platz.

sentence.en: Dancheong patterns are painted on the wood.
sentence.de: Dancheong-Muster werden auf das Holz gemalt.

observe.ko: 단청의 색과 무늬가 목재 위에 놓여요. 장식 아래에서 건물을 받치는 부재를 다시 찾아봐요.
observe.en: Dancheong colors and patterns cover the wood. Find the supporting members beneath the decoration.
observe.de: Dancheong-Farben und Muster bedecken das Holz. Such unter dem Schmuck die tragenden Bauteile.

steps.preserve: Installed structure retains the same nodes and thickness; only newly added parts and physically justified occlusion change.

productionNote.ko: 단청은 기존 공포·보 위의 표면 마감이며 부재 위치를 바꾸지 않습니다.
productionNote.en: Dancheong is a finish on existing brackets and beams; it does not move the structure.
productionNote.de: Dancheong ist die Oberfläche der vorhandenen Konsolen und Balken; ihre Lage ändert sich nicht.

sentence.en: It is a place for honoring ancestors.
sentence.de: Es ist ein Ort, an dem der Vorfahren gedacht wird.

observe.ko: 사당은 조상을 기리는 공간이에요. 사람이 문으로 들어가 마루 위에 서는 모습을 떠올려 봐요.
observe.en: The shrine is a place for honoring ancestors. Imagine someone entering through the doors and standing on its wooden floor.
observe.de: Der Ahnenschrein ist ein Ort des Gedenkens an die Vorfahren. Stell dir vor, wie jemand eintritt und auf dem Holzboden steht.

steps.preserve: Installed structure retains the same nodes and thickness; only newly added parts and physically justified occlusion change.

productionNote.ko: 승인 원본을 그대로 사용합니다. 특정 의례·신주·제기 배치는 추가 근거가 있을 때 설명합니다.
productionNote.en: Use the approved image unchanged; specific rites and ritual objects need separate evidence.
productionNote.de: Das freigegebene Bild bleibt unverändert; konkrete Rituale und Kultgegenstände benötigen eigene Belege.
